subtasks.description: Research existing code: Examine PR #33 implementation, understand codebase structure, and review current connectivity analysis capabilities
Implement core connectivity algorithm: Build graph-based connectivity analysis to identify disconnected circuit sections using connected components algorithms (BFS/DFS)
Implement ground path finding: Create path-finding algorithm to identify nodes and components reachable from ground reference point
Implement floating subcircuit detection: Detect subcircuits that have no electrical path to ground, identifying completely isolated circuit sections
Implement visualization: Create visual representation of isolated sections in the circuit schematic view, highlighting disconnected regions
Implement connection suggestions: Analyze isolated subcircuits and suggest potential valid connection points to integrate them with the main circuit
